prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
A reasonable first call is **Roof Master’s Remodeling Inc.** It serves Joplin and offers both interior renovation and repair work, as well as roofing and other exterior projects. The BBB listing shows it as accredited with an A+ rating. Call **(417) 726-5226** to ask whether your specific project is a fit. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/general-contractor/roof-masters-remodeling-inc-0734-1000013706)

For a broader remodel or general-construction project, **American Construction Inc.** is another Joplin option; its BBB listing also shows an A+ rating. Call **(417) 781-6811**. [Company website](https://www.americanconstructionincorporated.com/)

BBB ratings are a useful screening signal, not a guarantee of workmanship. Before hiring, get at least three written bids, ask for recent local references and proof of insurance, and make sure the contract spells out scope, materials, schedule, payment milestones, and who handles permits.
